scope: Advertising connector readiness. Existing hosted service listings are described in docs/SERVICES.html; no live paid advertising or external demand connection is asserted here.

readiness_definitions.DOCUMENTED: An official provider route is documented; no runtime connector is asserted.
readiness_definitions.LOCAL_FIXTURE: Request construction, response parsing or reconciliation is implemented for local fixtures; partner conformance and live operation are not established.
readiness_definitions.OWNER_CONFIG_REQUIRED: Promotion building blocks exist in the reviewed implementation; the owner must adopt and configure the programme before activation.

integrations.name: Covenant direct sponsored offers
integrations.pricing_note: The qualified-action route concerns an agreed completed Covenant outcome. Separate fixed-placement products follow their own terms.
integrations.money_flow: An advertiser funds an adopted promotion programme. Owner, integrator and operator treatment follows its agreed rules.
exists: Labelled sponsored-offer and auction building blocks
required_before_live: Owner-adopted programme and placement terms
Actual funding and delivery evidence
Qualified settlement and reconciliation

integrations.name: Covenant earned referral promotion
integrations.pricing_note: Non-cash promotion units; no CPM, CPC or CPA cash payout is asserted.
integrations.money_flow: No money transfer. Units redeem only for an explicitly labelled Referral reward placement under the adopted programme.
exists: Verified referral and separately verified opted-in sharing profiles
required_before_live: Owner-adopted eligibility and evidence rules
Independently pinned verification authority
Consenting listing and configured publisher

integrations.name: Google Ads
integrations.pricing_note: The Google product and bid strategy determine billing. A target CPA is a bidding or measurement goal, not a promise to charge only for a completed Covenant agreement.
integrations.money_flow: Campaign spend is an expense in the advertiser's Google account. API usage is free; provider advertising charges are separate from Covenant fees.
required_before_live: Enabled Google Cloud project and appropriate API access level
Authenticated access to the chosen advertiser account
Runtime marketing adapter and test-account qualification
Explicitly approved campaign, permissions and budget
integrations.zero_spend_test: Google test accounts have no billing and do not serve ads.
integrations.access_note: Google sunset developer tokens on 2026-09-09. New Google Ads API access is managed by the Google Cloud project.

integrations.name: Google AdSense for Content
integrations.pricing_note: Google describes publisher payments by impression using eCPM. Estimated revenue is not a received payment.
integrations.money_flow: External publisher earnings. Google publishes an 80% share after the advertiser platform's fee and approximately 68% when Google Ads buys the inventory.
required_before_live: Approved AdSense account and eligible approved site
Human-facing web ad implementation
Traffic-quality and applicable consent controls
Authenticated reporting connector if earnings import is wanted
integrations.inventory_boundary: Agent or bot activity is not offered as Google publisher impressions. The Management API is not an agent offer feed.

integrations.name: Google Ad Manager
integrations.pricing_note: Inventory, charging model, provider fees and revenue share depend on the publisher's actual products and contracts; none are assumed here.
integrations.money_flow: Publisher inventory and external advertising accounts remain separate from Covenant trading balances.
required_before_live: Valid AdSense account and Ad Manager network access
Enabled API and authenticated network permissions
Publisher inventory and browser implementation
Separately confirmed demand access, commercial terms and consent controls

integrations.name: OpenRTB 2.6 native demand
integrations.pricing_note: The current parser converts a CPM bid to a quoted per-impression amount. Qualified delivery and partner billing still need implementation and conformance.
integrations.money_flow: External network quotes and reconciliation. No provider earnings are credited to or transferred through a Covenant trading balance.
exists: Native request builder and structured creative parser
Local quote and signed-event reconciliation fixtures
required_before_live: Partner publisher seat accepting the intended inventory and audience
Actual publisher and site or app identity
Owner-supplied authenticated network transport
Adopted privacy signals and authorised seller records
Distinct qualified impression, click and conversion events
Verified partner events or reports and durable reconciliation
End-to-end partner conformance

integrations.name: Prebid Server native demand
integrations.pricing_note: Native CPM auction fixtures use the OpenRTB route. Running a server supplies no advertiser demand by itself.
integrations.money_flow: Publisher earnings follow the actual bidder and hosting agreements. Hosting costs and bidder terms have not been assumed.
exists: Native auction request path and local response fixtures
required_before_live: Configured Prebid Server and approved bidder seat
Partner acceptance of intended inventory and audience
OpenRTB delivery, privacy, reporting and reconciliation qualification
Actual hosting and bidder commercial terms

shared_controls.private_ad_request_data: Do not send private queries, agreement terms, credentials or customer records. Use only owner-approved public context.
shared_controls.accounting: Keep Covenant fees and licensing, external advertising spend, external publisher earnings and non-cash referral units separate.
